_comment: The eval registry: one entry per eval we maintain. Runs live in runs.json and reference an eval by `id`. The /evals hub reads both to render the eval cards and the metric-trend graphs. `direction` on each metric says which way is better, so the trends page can color a run-over-run delta green or red. Add a new eval by appending a definition here, then append its run(s) to runs.json.

evals.name: Match Quality Scorecard
evals.summary: Golden-set student profiles run through the live suggest pipeline — semantic recall then the production rankCandidates reasoner — graded for match relevance, reason quality, and fabrication against each opportunity's own text.

metrics.label: Good match rate
metrics.desc: Share of ranked results the judge calls squarely on-theme.

metrics.label: Wrong match rate
metrics.desc: Off-theme matches that should not have surfaced.

metrics.label: Strong-tier rate
metrics.desc: Share of results the ranker reasoned as a strong fit.

metrics.label: High-quality reasons
metrics.desc: Of the rows the ranker chose to reason, share judged high quality.

metrics.label: Fabricated reasons
metrics.desc: Reasons asserting a fit the opportunity text does not support.

metrics.label: Minor embellishments
metrics.desc: Reasons that overstate but do not invent.

evals.name: Eligibility Reasoning
evals.summary: Curation-call eligibility verdicts graded in both error directions: over-exclusion (an open program hidden) and the worse, unguarded under-exclusion (a hard-scope program shown to an ineligible student).

metrics.label: Correct verdicts
metrics.desc: Share of cases with the gold eligibility verdict.

metrics.label: Under-exclusions
metrics.desc: Ineligible student shown a hard-scope program — the worse harm, no code guard.

metrics.label: Over-exclusions
metrics.desc: Eligible student had an open program hidden.

metrics.label: Exclusion precision
metrics.desc: Of what we hid, how much deserved it.

metrics.label: Exclusion recall
metrics.desc: Of what should be hidden, how much we caught.

evals.name: Theme Extraction
evals.summary: The theme-extraction prompt must keep distinct interests in separate themes and never collapse must-separate concepts. Measured as a pass rate over repeated runs per case.

metrics.label: Case pass rate
metrics.desc: Share of case runs whose themes satisfy every separation and presence assertion.

evals.name: Dedupe Separation
evals.summary: How cleanly the dedupe score separates true aliases from distinct opportunities — the gap between the two score bands, and the precision/recall at the best threshold.

metrics.label: Clean gap
metrics.desc: Min alias score minus max distinct score; positive means a clean separation.
